origin.details: A length-one numeric vector. Logical values are not numeric. NA is logical and is false; NA_real_ is true.
origin.example:
# Generic check for scalars
see_if(is.scalar("a"))
see_if(is.scalar(1:10))

# string = scalar character vector
see_if(is.string(1:3))
see_if(is.string(c("a", "b")))
see_if(is.string("x"))

# number = scalar numeric/integer vector
see_if(is.number(1:3))
see_if(is.number(1.5))

# flag = scalar logical vector
see_if(is.flag(1:3))
see_if(is.flag("a"))
see_if(is.flag(c(FALSE, FALSE, TRUE)))
see_if(is.flag(FALSE))

# count = scalar positive integer
see_if(is.count("a"))
see_if(is.count(-1))
see_if(is.count(1:5))
see_if(is.count(1.5))
see_if(is.count(1))

translation.details: A length-one numeric value. bool is excluded. Logical NA is false; NA_real_ is true.
translation.example:
from assertthat import see_if

# Generic check for scalars
print(see_if('is.scalar("a")'))
print(see_if("is.scalar(1:10)"))

# string = scalar character vector
print(see_if("is.string(1:3)"))
print(see_if('is.string(c("a", "b"))'))
print(see_if('is.string("x")'))

# number = scalar numeric/integer vector
print(see_if("is.number(1:3)"))
print(see_if("is.number(1.5)"))

# flag = scalar logical vector
print(see_if("is.flag(1:3)"))
print(see_if('is.flag("a")'))
print(see_if("is.flag(c(FALSE, FALSE, TRUE))"))
print(see_if("is.flag(FALSE)"))

# count = scalar positive integer
print(see_if('is.count("a")'))
print(see_if("is.count(-1)"))
print(see_if("is.count(1:5)"))
print(see_if("is.count(1.5)"))
print(see_if("is.count(1)"))
